card.summary: The Prevent Government Shutdowns Act of 2026 provides automatic temporary funding for federal programs, projects, and activities if regular appropriations bills are not enacted before a new fiscal year begins. It provides funding in 14-day increments at the rate of operations from the prior fiscal year. It also restricts official travel, campaign fund usage for official travel, and congressional recesses, and limits the consideration of unrelated legislation for members of Congress and certain federal employees during periods of automatic continuing appropriations.

summary: The Prevent Government Shutdowns Act automatically provides temporary funding to prevent government shutdowns if regular appropriations bills are not enacted before a new fiscal year begins. During this funding lapse, the bill restricts official travel and campaign funds for official travel by Members of Congress and certain federal employees, limits legislative business and recesses in Congress, and requires daily quorum calls.

affected_groups.effect: Face restrictions on official travel, bans on using campaign funds for official travel, limits on recesses and adjournments, and mandatory daily quorum calls during funding lapses.
affected_groups.group: Members of Congress and Congressional Staff

affected_groups.effect: Subject to the same official travel restrictions as congressional staff during periods of automatic continuing appropriations.
affected_groups.group: Office of Management and Budget (OMB) Officers and Employees

affected_groups.effect: Receive automatic 14-day extensions of funding based on prior-year levels to prevent shutdowns when regular appropriations are delayed.

key_provisions: Provides automatic continuing appropriations in 14-day increments at the prior fiscal year's rate of operations when regular appropriations lapse.
Bans the use of official funds and campaign donations for official travel by Members of Congress and specified executive and legislative employees during a funding lapse, with limited exceptions.
Restricts floor activity in the Senate and House primarily to appropriations measures, debt limit legislation, and certain nominations or program extensions after 30 days.
Prohibits Congress from recessing or adjourning for more than 23 hours during a funding lapse.
Requires a daily quorum call in both chambers at noon during any period of automatic continuing appropriations.

summary_detail.plain_summary: The Prevent Government Shutdowns Act automatically provides temporary funding to prevent government shutdowns if regular appropriations bills are not enacted before a new fiscal year begins. During this funding lapse, the bill restricts official travel and campaign funds for official travel by Members of Congress and certain federal employees, limits legislative business and recesses in Congress, and requires daily quorum calls.
summary_detail.significance: This bill alters federal budgeting procedures by creating an automatic mechanism to fund government operations and avert shutdowns while penalizing lawmakers and specific personnel with operational restrictions until full appropriations are enacted.
